t: A highland kingdom of central Madagascar, reunited by Andrianampoinimerina, who made Antananarivo its capital around 1794.
Radama I's alliance with Britain from 1817 let it conquer much of the island as the Kingdom of Madagascar.
France invaded in 1883–85 and 1895 and abolished the monarchy in 1897, exiling Queen Ranavalona III.
dyk: Merina markets used Spanish and French silver dollars cut into small fragments and weighed on tiny scales, rather than counted as whole coins.
ev: Andriamanelo traditionally founds the Merina royal line
Andrianampoinimerina seizes power at Ambohimanga and begins reuniting Imerina
Radama I's treaty with Britain ends slave exports and brings arms and training
Ranavalona I bans Christianity; the Malagasy Bible is published
Ranavalona II and Rainilaiarivony are baptised; the royal talismans are burned
The Code of 305 Articles is promulgated
French troops under General Duchesne take Antananarivo
France abolishes the monarchy and exiles Ranavalona III

f.capital: Antananarivo; Ambohimanga under Andrianampoinimerina before c. 1794
